ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a galvanic cell apparatus. In the beaker on the left there is a copper electrode, labeled Cu and CuNO3; in the beaker on the right there is a zinc electrode, labeled Zn and Zn(NO3)2; the salt bridge in the middle is labeled NaBr. The overall reaction given at the bottom of the image is: 2Cu+(aq) + Zn(s) → 2Cu(s) + Zn2+(aq), and it is marked E° = +1.28 V. Reasoning: According to the overall reaction in the figure, 2 mol Cu+ are reduced to form 2 mol Cu(s). Each Cu+ gains 1 electron to form Cu(s), so producing 1 mol Cu(s) requires transferring 1 mol electrons. The problem asks for producing 127 g Cu. Using the molar mass of copper, 63.5 g/mol, calculate: 127 g ÷ 63.5 g/mol = 2 mol Cu. Therefore the amount of electrons that needs to be transferred is 2 mol.

Half-Cell A: Strip of Cu(s) in $CuNO_3(aq)$

Half-Cell B: Strip of Zn(s) in $Zn(NO_3)_2(aq)$

When the cells are connected according to the following diagram, the following reaction occurs. How many moles of electrons must be transferred to create 127 g of copper?

method.method_draft: First inspect the diagram and use the net reaction shown at the bottom: 2Cu+(aq) + Zn(s) -> 2Cu(s) + Zn2+(aq). From this reaction, one reaction event transfers 2 mol electrons from Zn to make 2 mol Cu(s), so the ratio is 1 mol e- per 1 mol Cu. Then use the text target mass: 127 g Cu / 63.5 g mol^-1 = 2 mol Cu. Therefore 2 mol electrons must be transferred.

图像描述：图中是一个原电池装置，左侧烧杯中有铜电极，标注为 Cu 和 CuNO3；右侧烧杯中有锌电极，标注为 Zn 和 Zn(NO3)2；中间盐桥标注为 NaBr。图像底部给出的总反应是：2Cu+(aq) + Zn(s) → 2Cu(s) + Zn2+(aq)，并标有 E° = +1.28 V。

推理：根据图中总反应，2 mol Cu+ 被还原生成 2 mol Cu(s)。每个 Cu+ 得到 1 个电子生成 Cu(s)，所以生成 1 mol Cu(s) 需要转移 1 mol 电子。题目要求生成 127 g Cu。用铜的摩尔质量 63.5 g/mol 计算：127 g ÷ 63.5 g/mol = 2 mol Cu。因此需要转移的电子物质的量为 2 mol。
